preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and 3 <= N <= 1000 for N in N_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is an integer between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 0 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A) for A in A_list)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the array A contains N integers between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 2000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly 3 lines per test case.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'NO' and stdout_lines[3*k+1] == '' and stdout_lines[3*k+2] == '') or (stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'YES' and len(stdout_lines[3*k+1].split()) == N_list[k] and len(stdout_lines[3*k+2].split()) == N_list[k]) for k in range(T))
postconditions.description: For each test case, if the answer is NO, only 'NO' is printed. If YES, two lines follow containing N integers each.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'NO') or (sorted([int(x) for x in stdout_lines[3*k+1].split()]) == sorted(A_list[k]) and sorted([int(x) for x in stdout_lines[3*k+2].split()]) == sorted(A_list[k])) for k in range(T))
postconditions.description: If YES is output, the two arrays B and C are permutations of the input array A.

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'NO') or (all(not (sorted(B[k][i:j+1]) == sorted(C[k][i:j+1])) for i in range(N_list[k]) for j in range(i, N_list[k]) if not (i == 0 and j == N_list[k]-1)) for k in range(T) if stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If YES is output, for the generated permutations B and C, no subarray B[i:j] (1-indexed, 1<=i<=j<=N, excluding the full array) is a permutation of C[i:j].

postconditions.expression: all((stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'NO') or (any(sorted(B[k][i:j+1]) == sorted(C[k][i:j+1]) for i in range(N_list[k]) for j in range(i, N_list[k]) if not (i == 0 and j == N_list[k]-1)) == False for k in range(T) if stdout_lines[3*k].strip().upper() == 'YES')
postconditions.description: If YES is output, the condition that no proper subarray pair is a permutation is strictly satisfied.
